context: Tech shares lifted the Nasdaq while the S&P 500 slipped and Treasury yields rose, as investors looked past cooler inflation data and weighed Fed rate hike signals.

items.why: Announced a $1.2 billion Vultr server order and raised revenue targets.
items.sentiment: Stock closed at a record high on the news.
items.judge_note: h78 (Investopedia) and h79 (simplywall.st) together confirm $1.2B Vultr order and raised revenue targets. h78 and h89 (Yahoo Finance) confirm record closing high.

items.why: Chip stocks rose as Intel capped a surprisingly strong September.
items.sentiment: Stock outperformed competitors on strong trading.
items.judge_note: h93 (Yahoo Finance) and h102 (24/7 Wall St.) confirm Intel capped a surprisingly strong September. h93 and h95 (MarketWatch) confirm Intel outperformed competitors on strong trading.

items.why: Tech shares lifted the Nasdaq while the S&P 500 slipped as Treasury yields rose.
items.sentiment: Investors weighed cooler inflation against hotter Treasury yields.
items.judge_note: WSJ (h326), Reuters (h325), and TV News Check (h333) confirm tech lifted Nasdaq while S&P 500 slipped; multiple headlines confirm Treasury yields rose as the cause. IBD (h323) and Anadolu Ajansı (h334) confirm investors weighed cooler inflation against hotter yields.

items.why: Beat Q4 estimates and raised fiscal 2027 outlook, but investors sold the news.
items.sentiment: Shares fell despite the earnings beat.
items.judge_note: WHY supported by multiple publishers (Yahoo Finance, Quiver Quantitative, GuruFocus) stating beat + raised fiscal 2027 outlook + sell-the-news reaction. SENTIMENT widely supported across many publishers.

items.why: Beat Q4 estimates and issued a strong Q1 outlook as data center revenue jumped.
items.sentiment: Shares showed little net change after hours despite the beat.
items.judge_note: WHY supported by CNBC, Yahoo Finance, and Seeking Alpha stating beat + strong Q1 outlook; CNBC also notes data center revenue jump. SENTIMENT supported by Investing.com (shares trim gains) and Barron's (stock isn't moving).

dropped.why: Wells Fargo called the Pixel install spike a false start.
